info.title: Cruscotto Italia - Municipal data API
info.summary: Open data of Italian municipalities, one JSON or GeoJSON file per source and per municipality.
info.description:
Read-only REST API of Cruscotto Italia (AgID). Each resource is a static file per municipality, identified by the 6-digit ISTAT code.

**Access**: GET only, no registration and no key, open CORS (Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *).

**ISTAT codes**: use the code of the current municipality (list in /istat-coords.json). Previous codes of recoded municipalities are served automatically (table in /lookup/variazioni_istat.json).

**Updates**: each source has its own schedule; the reference date of the data is in the metadata fields of the file (`_anno_riferimento`, `_data_period` etc.), the file date in the Last-Modified header. Conditional requests are supported (ETag, 304).

**Usage limits** (per IP address): per-municipality files 2 requests per second with bursts up to 80; aggregated and `_full` archives 10 requests per second with bursts up to 60; 8 simultaneous connections on /data/. Above 3,000 requests in 10 minutes the automatic block lasts 24 hours and doubles at each repeat, up to 4 weeks. When a limit is exceeded the response is 429: wait and retry with increasing intervals. Details and good practices: https://cruscotto-italia.dati.gov.it/api.html?lang=en#limiti

**Testing from the API page**: it shows what the data looks like. Lists in the displayed response are limited to 1000 items and the heaviest files cannot be tested from the page: for the full data use calls from code or from the command line.

**Licence**: CC BY 4.0, with attribution to the data holder stated for each path.

istat.name: istat
istat.description: ISTAT code of the municipality, 6 digits (e.g. 075035 Lecce).

LastModified.description: Date of the last regeneration of the file.

NonTrovato.description: Unknown municipality or source, or source not available for that municipality.

TroppeRichieste.description: Per-IP rate limit exceeded (see info.description): wait and retry with increasing intervals.

Shard.description: Source-specific structure. Common metadata fields start with _ (not all present in every source). The schema is descriptive: sources may add fields over time.
